description: Intellist is an iPhone home inventory that uses NFC tags on bins, shelves, and rooms. Connect it to ChatGPT to find where you stored something, see what's in any bin or room, log new items, update quantities, and check off shopping or packing lists, including lists shared with your family through groups. Changes sync to the Intellist app. ChatGPT can't permanently delete lists or items.

defaultPrompt: What's still on my grocery list?
Add milk and eggs to my grocery list.
